Subject: Seattle exec workshop — logistics check + day 2 venue

Hi Erin / Jacob —

Quick logistics check ahead of next week's exec workshop in Seattle. Flights look good, hotel is confirmed, and the client deliverables for Day 1/Day 2 are lined up. Two quick asks:

- Can you confirm whether the Friday (day 2) executive roundtable still needs our office boardroom? We reserved the 12-person boardroom at Redwood Tower.
- If there's any change to the exec schedule (talk time shifts or last-minute attendees), flag us asap so we can adjust catering and AV.

Attaching my itinerary and the current floorplan. I’ll loop on any travel hold requests if you need us to delay flights.

Thanks —
Jordan

jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147

From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@seaborntech.com>

Cc: Jacob Miller <jmiller@seaborntech.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Seattle exec workshop — logistics check + day 2 venue

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick update from our side: our CTO was just pulled into a late investor review on Friday afternoon and cannot make the 2pm slot in the boardroom. We need to shift the day 2 executive session to the morning (9–11am) or move it offsite to a nearby hotel boardroom that can accommodate a slightly different AV setup.

If you can accommodate a morning session at Redwood Tower, great. If not, we’ll need the hotel option. Either way, can you hold any non-refundable flights for the team until we lock timing? I’ll confirm by 3pm PST today. Apologies for the scramble — last-minute conflict at our exec table.

—Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Product Ops, Seaborn Tech
erin.walsh@seaborntech.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Seattle exec workshop — logistics check + day 2 venue

FYI — Seaborn’s CTO conflict just came in. They want either 9–11am at our boardroom or to move day 2 to a hotel boardroom near SEA. Two asks:

1) Stephanie — can you check with venue ops whether we can turn the boardroom over for a 9am session (catering, AV precheck at 7:30am)?
2) Marissa — please hold our team’s outbound flights for Friday afternoon (non-refundable hold) for 24 hours. If we end up moving to a morning session, we'll cancel the afternoon legs. If we switch to the hotel, we’ll need a quick hotel boardroom rec and AV quote.

If Erin confirms the morning by 3pm, we’ll proceed with in-office. If they want hotel, we need vendor availability and a plan to transport one whiteboard and our tabletop mic.

Short and urgent — thanks.

Jordan

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Seattle exec workshop — logistics check + day 2 venue

Jordan —

Checked with venue ops. We can turn the boardroom for a 9am start; catering can be prep’d for a continental breakfast arriving at 8:45am. AV tech can be on-site by 7:30am for a mic check. If they decide to move to a hotel, I’ve already pinged two nearby hotels (Inn at Harbor & The Meridian) and both have 10–14 person boardrooms available at 9am; The Meridian can provide in-room HDMI, a dedicated tech, and a podium mic for +$225.

I’ve placed a 24-hour hold on the Redwood Tower boardroom and asked Marissa to put the flights on hold. Updated venue-floorplan attached (hotel layout included).

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Event Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@seaborntech.com>, Jacob Miller <jmiller@seaborntech.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 17:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Seattle exec workshop — logistics check + day 2 venue

Erin / Jacob —

Thanks for the quick reply. Per Stephanie: we can do either. If the CTO can join 9–11am at Redwood Tower, we’ll host in office (breakfast served). If not, The Meridian is confirmed as an immediate backup; the AV add-on is $225 and they can handle HDMI + mic.

Please confirm final preference by 12:00pm PST tomorrow so we can finalize flight adjustments and catering. We’ve held flights and the boardroom for 24 hours. If you confirm hotel, we’ll switch venue and send a calendar update with new room details + directions from the airport.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
